title.orig: RFC 2324: Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol (HTCPCP/1.0)
title.en: RFC 2324: Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol
title.zh: RFC 2324：超文本咖啡壶控制协议

edition.en: The plain-text RFC 2324 from rfc-editor.org, with page headers and footers removed, prose re-flowed and the grammar rules kept in fixed-width blocks; angle brackets around URLs are shown as ⟨ ⟩.
edition.zh: 据 rfc-editor.org 的纯文本 RFC 2324；去掉了页眉页脚，正文重排，语法规则保留为等宽代码块；网址两侧的尖括号以 ⟨ ⟩ 显示。

note.en: Larry Masinter’s April 1998 RFC extends HTTP to control coffee pots, adding a BREW method, an Accept-Additions header for milk and syrup, and error code 418, ‘I’m a teapot’, which many web servers and frameworks still recognise. It parodies the urge to give every device a protocol and to build everything on HTTP because HTTP is everywhere. Notice the Security Considerations: ‘Anyone who gets in between me and my morning coffee should be insecure.’
note.zh: 拉里·马辛特 1998 年愚人节发布的这份 RFC，把 HTTP 扩展到控制咖啡壶：增加 BREW 方法、用来点牛奶和糖浆的 Accept-Additions 首部，以及错误码 418“我是一把茶壶”——许多网络服务器和框架至今仍能识别它。它戏仿的是“给每种设备都配一个协议”的冲动，以及因为 HTTP 无处不在就把一切都建在 HTTP 上的习惯。协议一本正经地规定：用 BREW 方法（也可以用 POST，但不提倡）让咖啡壶开始煮咖啡，用 WHEN 方法在牛奶加够时喊“停”；Accept-Additions 首部可以点奶油、糖浆、甜味剂、香料和酒；coffee: 网址方案列出了二十多种语言里“咖啡”一词的写法；咖啡壶应当用网络时间协议校准时钟；咖啡壶不用火，所以本不需要防火墙。“安全考量”一节则说，任何挡在作者和他早晨那杯咖啡之间的人都该感到不安，还警告了“拒绝咖啡服务”攻击。原文按许可要求逐字收录，并完整保留互联网协会的版权声明，不作翻译。

excerpt.orig: Any attempt to brew coffee with a teapot should result in the error code “418 I’m a teapot”. The resulting entity body MAY be short and stout.
excerpt.en: Any attempt to brew coffee with a teapot should result in the error code “418 I’m a teapot”. The resulting entity body MAY be short and stout.
excerpt.zh: 任何试图用茶壶煮咖啡的尝试，都应当得到错误码“418 I'm a teapot”。所产生的实体主体可以（MAY）矮而胖。
